name: Midnight Roots | 100mg Full Moon Chocolate | Blue Moon (1:1 THC:THCv)
description:
Drift into a delicious night's sleep with Full Moon – Bluesberry Pie. Born from our dedication to crafting unparalleled cannabis experiences, this flavor captures the mouthwatering essence of homemade blueberry pie while harnessing the soothing power of CBN and CBD to cradle you into perfect rest.

Indulge in the smooth, dessert-inspired flavor of blueberries wrapped in a flaky, golden crust, and let the calming effects guide you into the deep, restorative sleep you deserve. Because at Midnight Roots, it’s not just about cannabis—it's about crafting moments that connect us, soothe us, and inspire us. Ready to chase the moon? Sweet dreams are only a bite away.
